body.name: \(R_{\mathrm{or}}(\gamma)\)
body.construction: For every nonempty \(\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(\gamma)\), define \(R_{\mathrm{or}}(\gamma)=\inf_{\mathcal C\in\mathfrak H_\gamma}\sup_{\vartheta\in\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(\gamma)}\mathbb E_\vartheta[\operatorname{diam}_2\{\mathcal C(Y_0,Y_1;\gamma)\}]\).
